residual_risk: Limits, each a plain fact. The tool is a drafting aid for six parts a planning tool can supply; a person writes the rest and approves the contract. One reader will judge the effort saved (stage 2) and no customer format has been tried (stage 3). The draft copies text verbatim, so whatever a planning file says, including a false statement, is quoted under its source file. The sources of the Kiro example are third-party descriptions. The published copy contains the fixtures, which carry no scan pattern.
